links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM time toxicity extraction across 3 repeated runs on real-world protocols
links.effect: Vanilla pipeline: 95.3% clinically acceptable (IQR ≤ 3 days) across 3 runs on 644 protocols; 82.0% perfect stability (IQR = 0), so about 18% of protocols showed run-to-run variation.
links.quote: However, on real-world protocols, the vanilla pipeline showed superior reproducibility: 95.3% clinically acceptable accuracy (IQR $\leq$ 3 days) across 3 runs on 644 protocols, with 82.0% perfect stability (IQR = 0).
